summary: A page the tab left was kept frozen in the back/forward cache with its SQLite worker still holding the OPFS handles, so the next page's local database open waited past its 8s deadline and booted on a disposable in-memory database; offline the person's own space then read as someone else's and their drafts were missing (the flaky offline Numberlink release journey, Release run 40628012072). HTML documents are now served no-store, which keeps them out of the cache.
